source: Project owner instruction, 2026-10-22: Codex performs text recognition and image work; retain necessary audio models and unify video editing.
image_editing_preference: ImageGen first for suitable image work. Prefer a reviewed same-shot ImageGen reference with Wan when it helps define the intended visual repair; independent Wan and other suitable routes remain available. See knowledge/rules/imagegen-first-v3.md.

tts_recovery.selection: Small live probes confirmed both alternatives are callable. Use a source, locale and request-budget bound grant for a replacement after a confirmed zero-credit transient failure. Keep any unresolved request and its reservation.
